title: Vegan Gluten-Free Oatmeal Chia Chocolate Chip

ingredientSections.heading: Vegan Gluten-Free Oatmeal Chia Chocolate Chip
items: 1¼ Cup of your favourite All-purpose flour blend (see flour blending basics below)
½ Cup Earth Balance butter spread
¾ Cup Organic coconut sugar or Organic cane sugar
1 Flax Egg (1 Tbsp Organic gluten-free ground flax whisked with 3 Tbsp of lukewarm water)

methodSections.heading: Vegan Gluten-Free Oatmeal Chia Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven the 180°C (350°F) and line two large baking trays with parchment paper.
In the bowl of a stand mixer, using the paddle attachment, cream the butter and sugar together at a medium speed until light and fluffy. Add the flax egg and vanilla mix a little longer.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, xanthan gum, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add to the wet ingredients and mix until just blended
Mix through the chocolate chips, oats, chia seeds and coconut.
Using a tablespoon, scoop the cookie dough onto the prepared cookie sheets and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Remove from oven and allow to cool completely on the oven tray and then remove and place on a wire rack.
